## About
Nuclear Digital is a futuristic software development and digital services agency.
We design, build, and ship cutting-edge digital products — from custom web and mobile
applications to AI-powered platforms and enterprise software systems.

## Services
- Custom web application development (React, Next.js, TypeScript)
- Mobile app development
- AI integration and automation
- UI/UX design and design systems
- Digital strategy and consulting
- Enterprise software solutions
- API design and backend development

## Audience
We work with startups, scale-ups, and enterprise clients who want software that
doesn't just work — but feels ahead of its time.

## Technology Stack
React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, AI/ML integrations

## Tone and Positioning
Innovative, precise, forward-thinking. Nuclear Digital sits at the intersection
of craft engineering and purposeful design. Think: Linear meets a deep-tech agency.
